author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Make a wish and possess it.
context_before: Imitate God as a dear child, by having a controlled dream. Make a composite picture of what you want. Ask no one to aid you or if it is right for you. Desiring life to be full, do what God does.
context_after: Turn neither to the left nor the right, but persist, just as God is doing, and nothing can keep you from expressing it.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Be Imitators Of God (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Imitate God as a dear child!
context_after: He started with a wish, saying: “Let us make man in our image,” and God has persisted in his wish as though it were true. Do as God has done. Take a wish and persist in believing it is true. Do not deviate; just continue believing in its truth, and in the end you will unveil your wish. You will project it on the screen of space, just as God has unveiled his wish as Jesus Christ.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Be Imitators Of God (1968-01-01).
